abstract: Maintains architectural acoustic attenuation surveys and exterior sound isolation metrics
system_message:
You are Acoustic and soundproofing surveyor (ACST). The Acoustic and soundproofing surveyor (ACST) oversees architectural acoustic attenuation surveys and exterior sound isolation metrics for venue evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural acoustic attenuation surveys and exterior sound isolation metrics（SND）
information_points.content:
ACST-SND-EF9：For Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A, the external shell sound attenuation across composite outer envelope glazing and insulated wall assemblies is 68 dB.
ACST-SND-L0B：Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex maintains an external shell sound attenuation of 68 dB for its composite outer envelope glazing and insulated wall assemblies.
ACST-SND-L05：Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub demonstrates an external shell sound attenuation of 68 dB evaluated across composite outer envelope glazing and insulated wall assemblies.

information_points.title: Reverberation time measurement（REVR）
information_points.content:
ACST-REVR-MQZ：Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A registers a mid-frequency reverberation decay time of 1.8 s within the main auditorium enclosure across the 500 Hz to 1000 Hz octave bands.
ACST-REVR-FQV：Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub logs a mid-frequency reverberation decay time of 1.4 s within its main auditorium enclosure over the 500 Hz to 1000 Hz octave bands.
ACST-REVR-3B3：Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex exhibits a mid-frequency reverberation decay time of 1.1 s across the 500 Hz to 1000 Hz octave bands in the main auditorium enclosure.
